purpose: Fresh development verification plus read-only shadow collision/loss instrumentation; no terminal or optimizer execution
schedule: For each case: AD base; epsilon 1 four blocks; AD base; epsilon 2 four blocks; AD base. Each block begins with a base forward evaluation; signs alternate (+,-),(-,+),(+,-),(-,+). Fixed case order.
observer_scope: Independent shadow kernels before original grid_op/g2p. Recompute inputs and tangential norm, do not divide or write simulator fields. Original forward/backward kernels unmodified. Shadow arithmetic can differ from compiled temporaries. Store per-substep contact masks and per-action MILK L1 sign snapshots.

gate.requires: All five cases pass both predeclared epsilons; observer runs have no zero/<=EPS/invalid shadow norms, meet baseline loss/AD agreement, and fresh-process control meets agreement. Empirical ranges are descriptive, not confidence bounds. No noise allowance is added to the AD/FD tolerance.

scope: Four/eight-step partial diff loss with original max_loss_steps=1000; no original terminal step 999. Passing is engineering readiness only, not contact/physics correctness or paper replication. No automatic transition to terminal/optimization. Prior experiment files and failed gate remain unchanged.
